blocks.title: Control Center Design for Top Industry Leaders

blocks.text: Control Center Design for Top Industry Leaders

blocks.html: ISYSTEMS AUTOMATION designs, manufactures and supplies control room equipment and operator furniture. Clients include LUKOIL Energy and Gas, Dalkia Termo Prahova and Nuclearelectrica.

The primary objective of our control center designs is to guarantee comfort, safety, and unobstructed access for operational personnel to all workplace-related equipment. We meticulously consider various groups of factors and technical requirements to enhance personnel comfort and safety.

Special attention is dedicated to the acoustics of the room. To mitigate acoustic noise, special grilles equipped with noise-absorbing material can be installed on the ceiling. Walls feature antistatic panels, while modular carpets cover the floors. The strategic placement of loudspeakers ensures that emergency and alarm situations are communicated effectively, regardless of the operator's position.

The layout and arrangement of furniture and equipment prioritize accessibility to operational equipment, communication facilities, and other necessary tools. Furniture arrangement facilitates free movement and open communication among personnel. The design ensures that operational staff maintain a direct line of sight to essential equipment, and hierarchies are respected with dispatchers having quick access and visual contact with subordinates. Exit routes are carefully planned to allow swift evacuation in case of emergencies.

Our projects incorporate essential auxiliary equipment such as alarms, fire alarms, lighting systems, access control, and air conditioning. Control panels for this equipment are positioned for easy access.

Workstations are strategically placed to benefit from daylight without causing glare or discomfort. The lighting system is designed to avoid interference with screen readability and to prevent glare and flicker. Adjustable lighting solutions cater to different times of the shift, with individual lamps provided if necessary. Internal temperature, humidity, and air circulation are closely monitored to maintain an optimal working environment.
Furniture, equipment, and finishing materials are chosen based on the 24/7 operational nature of the room to ensure durability and comfort.
Equipment is designed for easy access for maintenance and repair, with clear labeling to minimize human error.

Critical equipment benefits from backup power supplies from independent sources, ensuring uninterruptible operations. Emergency lighting and power systems ensure that power failures do not impede control or exit routes.

The operator interface is designed to be visually comfortable, with calm colors for normal operations and bright colors for emergencies. Different color schemes and sound signals help operators quickly identify and respond to emergency situations.
ISYSTEMS AUTOMATION continues to set new standards in control center design, ensuring that our clients receive the most advanced, safe, and comfortable solutions for their operational needs.
ISYSTEMS AUTOMATION is a leading name in Engineering & Consulting, Protection Systems, and Process Control & Electrical Automation. As of today, we can now follow the entire cycle for any project.

This expansion reflects our ongoing commitment to professionalism, responsibility, innovation, and flexibility. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing clients with the confidence to make informed decisions, ensuring the highest levels of efficiency, energy savings, and environmental stewardship.
